newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research started.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group Inc said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of Lam Research Corp with a short-term hold rating and a long-term buy rating.
-- Analyst Michael O'Brien said in a research note his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate was $0.61 per share and his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate was $1.34 per share.
-- He set a 12-month price target of $45 per share.

-- "Lam has always been a great technology company but it needs to focus on its operational model," he said. "They are bringing in the right upper management to do that, but until cost reduction programs start reaching goals, we remain cautious on the stock."
